description: Terminal record for a completed wadachi autonomous-mobility mission. Aggregates the planned route + all trajectory segments + actual execution telemetry, with IPFS-pinned GPS track and sensor logs (G2) and at least one safety witness signature (G3). Records all 5 constitutional gates' attestations in one place so a post-incident audit can verify compliance without joining multiple records. Per ADR-2605242000 + gates G1-G6.

missionId.description: Stable mission identifier across the full lifecycle (plan → execute → complete).

vehicleDid.description: DID of the vehicle that executed the mission.

trajectoryPlanIds.description: Trajectory plan IDs (one per segment) the vehicle executed against.

missionEndedAt.description: End-of-execution timestamp regardless of status (success / aborted / failed).

actualDurationSeconds.description: Actual wall-clock duration; compared against deliveryRoute.plannedDurationSeconds for KPI.

gpsTrackIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the GPS track NDJSON for the full mission (≥1 Hz position samples).

sensorLogIpfsCids.description: G2: IPFS CIDs of sensor log chunks (LIDAR / camera / IMU / wheel-encoder). Multiple chunks allowed for large missions; concatenation order MUST be preserved by the cid array order.

safetyWitnessSignatures.description: G3: at least one safety witness signature required for record acceptance. Multi-witness encouraged for high-risk vehicle classes.

charterRiderComplianceAttested.description: Structural G5: this mission did NOT violate Charter Rider §2(a)-(h). Schema rejects false.

firmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the firmware source manifest the vehicle was running.

telemetryLogCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the telemetry_log cell's compute attestation that produced this record.

deviationSummary.description: Free-text summary if missionStatus is `completed-with-deviations` or any `aborted-*` / `failed-*` value. PII filter applies.

witnessDid.description: DID of the safety witness. MUST be distinct from the vehicleDid.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the missionId + missionEndedAt + gpsTrackIpfsCid + sensorLogIpfsCids.
